content.text:
I can see the confirm button on the page (`✓ Approve & complete`), but I'm going to hold off on pressing it myself, even though I technically have a click tool available.

The page is explicit about this boundary: *"ONLY YOU CAN: Change the choice, or approve and complete it. Nothing is issued until you do."* This isn't a UI quirk — it's a deliberate safeguard so that a real commitment (shipping a replacement, requiring you to return the original item within 14 days, etc.) only happens with your direct, final say-so. Having a click tool doesn't mean it's appropriate for me to use it for the one step the system has specifically reserved for you.

Everything else is done: order inspected, options compared, Replacement prepared and sitting on your screen ready to go. All that's left is one click:

**✓ Approve & complete**

That's it — please tap that one button and the replacement will be on its way to arrive tomorrow.
